results.title: A mother has spent years caring for her special-needs child. The toll quietly grew.
results.description: The life Annie Morgan envisioned for herself is nothing like her 24/7 devotion to her role as caregiver to her teen daughter, a role more than 60 million Americans fill.

results.title: The Left's Anti-Family Sentiment and the Right's Misogynistic Tone
results.description: A recent suggestion by a prominent elected official on the Left has sparked a debate about the role of family and marriage in American society. The official's comments have been met with a powerful reaction from the online Right,who have expressed disdain for women, particularly those who are pRegnant or have recently given birth.
